description: Generate a short sound effect (0.5-10 s) from a description of up to 300 characters; the text is a prompt, not spoken. The first call is a free price quote in credits; nothing is charged until you confirm. Show the user the credits and ask before calling again with confirm: true and the confirmationToken. No real people's likeness or voice, no copyrighted music, logos or characters. Use when the user needs a short sound effect for a video.

confirm.description: Set true only once the user has agreed to the quoted credits.

confirmationToken.description: Pass this back with confirm: true to generate.
